# ChatW - End-to-End Encrypted Private Messenger

> ChatW is a minimalist, high-performance private messaging application built with Rust (Axum backend) and Dioxus 0.7 (WebAssembly + Native Desktop frontend), featuring true zero-knowledge End-to-End Encryption (E2EE).

## Architecture & Cryptography
- Key Exchange: ECDH P-256 (NIST P-256)
- Key Derivation: HKDF-SHA-256 (per-message v2 ratchet derivation) & Argon2id (password-derived key backup)
- Message Encryption: AES-256-GCM (12-byte IV, 16-byte authentication tag, 34-byte header AAD)
- Digital Signatures: ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256
- Blind Relay: Backend server has zero knowledge and zero access to plaintext or private keys
- Local Key & Media Cache: Non-extractable Web Crypto vault + `CWLC1` AES-256-GCM encrypted OPFS/IndexedDB cache
- Real-time Transport: `CWBF2` encrypted binary WebSocket RPC with ECDH P-256 handshake and monotonic replay protection
- Media Pipeline: Pure-Rust `chatw-media-core` with adaptive AVIF/AV1, `CWCH3` chunked streaming E2EE, and 15-day cold compression
- WebRTC Audio/Video: P2P calling, Meet rooms, and voice channels with strict server-side ACLs
- Communities & Enterprise: Discord-style servers, categories, text/forum/voice channels, RBAC, and isolated enterprise workspace modules
- Security & Audit: Tamper-evident audit logs, atomic TOTP/backup 2FA, multi-device approval, and strict SSRF/CSP protections

## Source Code & Deployment
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/kiyogo/chart
- Backend: Rust 1.85+, Axum 0.8, SQLx, PostgreSQL 16+
- Frontend: Dioxus 0.7 (Rust WebAssembly + Native Desktop), Pure CSS (Flat Minimalist Design)
